edits.headline: Flash flood in Nepal's Gorkha district sweeps away about 35 houses
edits.subheadline: Several bridges were also swept away, and Nepal's disaster authority said no casualties had been reported, Outlook India reported.
editorialBody: A flash flood in Nepal's Gorkha district swept away around 35 houses and several bridges on 11 October, Outlook India reported. Nepal's National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority said no casualties had been reported, according to the same report.

In India, three people were killed when a Mini Cooper hit their scooter near Kochi airport, The News Minute reported. Kerala police rejected allegations of lapses and leniency in the case, Onmanorama reported.
Former US President Barack Obama endorsed Abdul El-Sayed for the US Senate in Michigan in a campaign advertisement, GV Wire reported.
In the UK, the singer Raye said ticket touts using AI bots had overwhelmed sign-ups for her Royal Albert Hall show, Capital FM reported.
